summary: AXIA Energia S.A., formerly Eletrobras, filed a Form 6-K announcing the voluntary delisting of its Common ADSs (AXIA) and Class C Preferred ADSs (AXIA PRC) from the NYSE. The delisting consolidates liquidity on B3, as ADSs represent only ~2.5% of outstanding shares. Last trading day is on or about August 6, 2026; effectiveness 10 days after filing Form 25. Post-delisting, ADSs will trade OTC via a Level 1 sponsored ADR with Citibank. The company will file Form 15F to deregister and suspend Exchange Act reporting. Watch for any SEC objections and the 90-day suspension timeline.
